annotations.title: Bridge statistics (Across, LayerZero, Stargate, Wormhole among Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP)

description: Across, LayerZero OFT / Stargate V2 and Wormhole (Token Bridge, NTT) since 2026-11-24, and Chainlink CCIP and the Base / OP Mainnet canonical bridges since 2026-11-27, transfers among Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and OP Mainnet, counted from ASPERN’s stored index (BridgeTransfer; only routes among the four). A canonical-bridge withdrawal stays sent through its 7-day challenge period. Since 2026-11-27 `agentsVsRest` (the Circle CCTP definition: sender or recipient a registered agent or x402 payer, value first), the Hyperliquid bridge (Arbitrum ↔ HyperCore) and, option A, transfers from the four to the outside chains switched on in order of volume (`outside`, that side named and not read). Per bridge lane (Across, LayerZero OFT, Stargate V2, Wormhole Token Bridge, Wormhole NTT, Chainlink CCIP, Base / OP canonical bridge, Hyperliquid Bridge): Tx (each transfer counted once at its source), USD (the source amount at the source hour from DefiLlama; unpriced transfers counted in Tx only), filled, median and p90 seconds to the destination event, and per UTC day (`read` false before the index first read a chain: not read, never zero). Per route (all 12 ordered pairs) Tx and USD, split by lane. `scale` is ONE scale across every lane and day so bars compare dollars. `index.state`: read, not_yet_read (the job has not run: nothing says there was no traffic) or unavailable. Circle CCTP is counted apart by cross_chain_stats; one transfer: cross_chain_trace. Never claims the addresses share an owner, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. FREE.

days.description: Window in days, default 30, at most 365.

name: bridge_stats

agentsVsRest.description: Agents against the rest (2026-11-27), the Circle CCTP definition: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), matchedOn, definition, total, agents and rest [transfers, usd, usdFormatted, shareOfUsd, shareOfTransfers] (null unless read: never zero agents for an unread split), byLane, says.

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

index.description: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), says, readSince, since per chain, job (enabled, everyMinutes, lastRunAt).

lanes.description: Per lane: version, bridge, label, mark, transfers, usd, unpriced, filled, medianSeconds, p90Seconds, perDay [day, read, transfers, usd, filled].

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

outside.description: Option A (2026-11-27): routes with one side outside the four (e.g. Base -> BNB Chain, Arbitrum -> HyperCore), that side named and not read: routes [route, sourceNetwork, destinationNetwork, transfers, usd], transfers, usd, says.

routes.description: Per route: route, sourceNetwork, destinationNetwork, covered, transfers, usd, byLane [version, transfers, usd].

says.description: One sentence, or why there are no figures.

scale.description: shared (true), maxDayUsd, maxDayTransfers, maxRouteUsd, says: one scale for every lane and route.

totals.description: transfers (Tx), usd, unpriced, filled over the window.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

window.description: from, through, days: every UTC day of the window.
